details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: revenue decline (S1) is followed by an explanation of improved profitability (S2) driven by lower cost of sales (S3), which in turn leads to higher gross profit and operating profit (S5). Subsequent statements on EBITDA (S6), net financial expenses (S7), and net profit (S8) maintain this causal chain. Financial-position items (S10–S12) are presented in a clear sequence, and cash-flow developments (S13–S14) are logically connected to the profitability narrative. Geographical and product breakdowns (S15–S16) are presented without internal contradictions or repetition. No sentence contradicts another, and the overall structure forms a single, logically connected narrative.
